title: Identity and Bank Verification of Northloop Payments Accounts
content:
A Northloop Payments account pays out only after identity and bank verification.

## Rule as applied by the payments desk

1. **Verification before payout.** A payments account pays out only after identity and bank verification. While the account is pending verification it does not pay out; when identity and bank account verification completes, the account becomes active.
2. **Name match.** When the plan requires the bank account holder name to match, the bank account holder name must match the profile name or the business name. Every Northloop Payments plan carries that requirement in its bank-details terms.
3. **Periodic re-verification.** Identity and bank details are re-verified every re-verification interval of the plan, counted from the date the account was verified. An account whose re-verification is more than the plan's re-verification grace days overdue is placed on hold with the reason re-verification overdue.
4. **Starting plan.** A new account starts on Payments Starter.
5. **Lapse.** An account still pending verification when its selling plan's verification deadline passes is closed together with that plan; the application lapses because verification was never completed.

## Account states this rule moves

| From | To | When |
|---|---|---|
| pending verification | active | identity and bank account verification completes |
| pending verification | closed | verification is never completed and the application lapses with the selling plan's verification deadline |
| active | on hold (reason: re-verification overdue) | re-verification is more than the grace days overdue |

## Questions answered

*From which date is the re-verification interval counted?* From the date the account was verified.

*When does an overdue re-verification hold payouts?* Only once the re-verification is more than the plan's grace days overdue; an account inside the grace days is not held for this reason.

*Which plan does a newly opened account start on?* Payments Starter.
